label: Sleeping Beauty accuracy cohorts
definition: The existing real-valued binary error from EpistemicAccuracy is reused. mondayRisk assigns fair expected error to exactly one designated first-Monday assessment per experiment. tokenRisk assigns expected SUM of squared errors to every awakening under the fair one-Heads/two-Tails protocol: half times (1-r) squared plus r squared. A constant policy r must be used at all indistinguishable awakenings. It is not divided by each realized experiment's token count. Dividing the expected sum by the expected count only rescales by a constant; averaging separately within each experiment instead gives mondayRisk for this constant policy. These are distinct epistemic cost aggregations with explicit populations, neither an obligatory norm by definition nor a monetary utility. Substantive credences lie in the unit interval; the polynomial minimizer theorem holds for all reals.
